name: Clash of Kings

description.0: A golden box lavishly inlaid with precious jewels. It houses a game much beloved by the kings of the sands.

passiveName: Without Heed for Day nor Night

0.0: Using an Elemental Skill grants the equipping character "Laws of the Board," which increases their ATK by <cryo>20%</cryo> and their Elemental Mastery by <cryo>100</cryo>. This effect lasts 6s and can trigger once every 12s. Does not stack. The duration of this effect will also be extended by 6s if the equipping character hits an opponent with a Charged Attack while it is active. The effect can be extended for max 6s in this way.
